title: Riff
description: Fall for the sound before the selfie. A music-first 18+ dating app that matches people through playlists, genres, favorite artists, and listening chemistry.

sections.title: Sticky Header
sections.summary: Custom SVG waveform logo, navigation links (`How It Works`, `Matches`, `Playlists`, `Stories`), mobile hamburger menu, and screenprint red "Join Riff" button.

sections.title: Hero Section (Two Phones, One Chemistry)
sections.summary: - Dual-phone mockup showcasing real profile cards (Mila, 24 and Julian, 26).

sections.title: Manifesto Section
sections.summary: - Wheat-pasted torn paper banners: *"THERE'S MORE TO A PERSON THAN A PHOTO"*.

sections.title: How It Works (Three Tracks)
sections.summary: - Interactive tape-head progress rail scrubbable across Track 01 (Drop your favorites), Track 02 (Find your overlap), and Track 03 (Start a conversation).

sections.title: Interactive Taste Matcher
sections.summary: - Left panel: clickable underground genres (Shoegaze, Post-Punk, Midwest Emo, Darkwave, etc.) and listening rituals (Night drives, Live gigs, Vinyl digging, Late-night headphones).

sections.title: Music Chemistry Case Study
sections.summary: - Segmented control toggling between Favorite Records, Concert Energy, and Late-Night Mixes.

sections.title: The Scene Playlist Wall
sections.summary: - Six mood-curated playlists with custom art sleeves and rotational offsets.

sections.title: Stories & Backstage Pass
sections.summary: - Carousel of real connection stories from East London, Glasgow, and Chicago.

customCodeBlocks.title: Riff Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: Riff Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads motion in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
